thesis.observe: BTC $84,623 (+2.2% 24h), ETH +2.7%, SOL +1.8%, HYPE +1.8%. thesis.infer: Price and OI rise together while funding stays near its floor, so we read this as new longs adding without crowded carry, with HYPE the exception (shorts paying). Consensus is pricing a hold on Oct 28; we read the risk as a hawkish tone given the 10Y above 5%. The disagreement: crypto OI is at a 30-day high while stablecoin supply is flat to lower and the Macro lens is Restrictive, so risk skews toward a leverage-led advance that is fragile if the dollar firms.
thesis.forecast: Base case (we lean here, low-confidence): BTC holds above the ETF cost basis ($81.7K) into the Oct 28 FOMC; a daily close below $81.7K breaks it and is hl-cycles' stated invalidation. Tail case (low-confidence): a daily close below the True Market Mean ($79.4K) could put the STH cost basis ($74.6K) in play. Second tail case (low-confidence): a dovish hold with oil under $100 may let stablecoin supply recover and support a move toward the Mean MVRV price ($105.7K), far overhead.
